The '''Conclamatus Glyph''' is an {{Epic}} Quest Item obtained in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Conclamatus Glyph''' can be obtained after starting {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}'s quest and imbuing the {{Item|Pernimius Glyph}}, then opening the chest at {{Coords|-51.5|73|-168.5}} in the barn within the {{Zone|Dreadfarm}}. Once given to Okron, it can no longer be obtained.

== Interface ==
{{/UI}}

== Usage ==
The '''Conclamatus Glyph''' can be given to {{NPCSprite|Sorcerer Okron}}. When given, he will task the player with using the {{Item|Warding Diamathame}} to imbue a spell onto the house.
